label: wAP BE
description: MikroTik wAP BE (RBwAP2nD-BE) — 1x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9531.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: 802.3af/at** (11-57 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 4 W.
